description: Check whether a crypto exchange serves a US state (50 states, DC and territories) or its UK FCA cryptoasset register FRN, promotion approver and FCA Warning List status. Leave "exchange" empty to list all tracked exchanges for that region.

exchange.description: A crypto exchange's name, for example "Coinbase", "Kraken" or "Binance". Leave empty for all tracked exchanges in the region.

region.description: A US state code or name (for example "NY", "New York", "Texas") or "UK" / "United Kingdom".

name: check_crypto_access
title: Check crypto exchange access (US states & UK FCA)
